verdict: bounded callback and ownership observations passed; lifecycle and fallback acceptance partial; final-close cleanup persistence unobserved
scope: Real callbacks from the published WindowManager alpha on the identified Googlebook, with two diagnostic document tasks, first-window close, remaining-window stop/return/recreate and bounded quiet sampling. Not physical-input or product qualification.

buildEvidence.boundary: Build/source/package records were reviewed separately; this evidence author performed no build or device action. Test-only failure injection is not device behavior.

time.clockBoundary: Host action records, device UTC and elapsed-realtime readings are separate clock evidence, not synchronized latency measurements. Shell exit-history timestamps have no encoded timezone and are not normalized here.

windowRoles.boundary: A/B labels are local to this 0.3.0 run. Task ID 1000150 also occurred in older runs; its new logical identity and process identify this observation, not prior state continuity.

acceptanceCases.evidence: Compiled public API methods, 31 JVM tests, lint, verified dependencies, packaged notices and two successful hosted checks; see exact source/build records. No product dependency selected.

acceptanceCases.outcome: pass for bounded actual callback observation
acceptanceCases.evidence: A epoch 1 recorded AUDIO_ON/TOUCH/VISUALS_ON, then AUDIO_ON/PRECISE_POINTER/VISUALS_ON. B also reported a real precise-pointer mode. No input hardware, audio, latency or display-performance inference.

Distinct logical/task/generation identities, independent B1/C2 markers, first A close with cleanup-complete while B remains active; recreated B rejects old-generation cleanup delivery at event 58 and accepts current state at 59.

A close and B minimize recorded cleanup completion; B returned in same generation at epoch 2, then recreated into a new generation/epoch 1. Four later revision 63 samples were stable over 4.144702 host seconds. Final last-window close terminated the process with no newly persisted lifecycle or cleanup callbacks; final cleanup success is unobserved. Broad race/long-running coverage remains outside this run.

Actual pending transitions and initial TOUCH are preserved, with font 1.0/density 260 unchanged. No persistent no-value, registration error, cleanup error or unavailable-library state was induced on hardware; those distinctions have source/JVM coverage only.

events.detail: Inspect the new task/window; return is not qualification.
Device metadata is shared by the process.
Inspect section errors; completion is not qualification.

earlyExportLimit.interpretation: An export immediately after launch still contained A only. The later revision 22 report establishes two retained live windows; the early filename does not prove two-window completion.

recreationBoundary.interpretation: The rejection is delivery of an old-generation cleanup snapshot, not an observed late mode callback. Sampled per-controller rejectedLateCallbackCount remained 0; ledger rejectedCallbackCount became 1.

quietness.interpretation: The first four-sample series is not stable. After the recorded Refresh and its saved update, the separate four-sample series stayed at 63. This short sample does not establish a soak test or exclude unpersisted/sampled counters.

finalClose.outcome: window/process absence observed; final callback persistence and cleanup success unobserved

latestPackageExitDiagnostic.subreasonBoundary: The shell-reported subreason is observed diagnostic output only, not a selected public SDK contract or an API called by this probe.

finalClose.interpretation: Report 63 predates last close and still marks B alive/subscribed. After close it is historical, not evidence of a live process, successful final unregister or persisted onDestroy. No final callback is fabricated; process teardown may prevent its observation or asynchronous save.

visualReview.boundary: Primary agent inspected the actual screenshots. This author checked report/history/control projections and command/result evidence without independently inspecting pixels or publishing raw UI.

notEstablished: Audio playback, audio permissions or actual visual rendering performance from AUDIO_ON/VISUALS_ON hints
External-display moves, alternate devices/builds or all alpha backends
Final last-window unregister completion or persisted destruction/cleanup callbacks
Real-device no-value, registration-failure, cleanup-failure or exhausted-admission outcomes
Leak freedom, hard IPC timeouts or long-running stability
Reboot/process-death restoration or remote-operation survival in this 0.3.0 run
Larger font behavior of this new APK; the separate font run used 0.2.0
Product dependency adoption, completed API09 qualification, P0-S2 closure or CAP-PLATFORM support

capabilityDecision.reason: Actual engagement observations are partial API09 evidence. Physical input, operation-specific lifecycle and remaining platform acceptance are separate.
